Did not see an answer to this on the newsgroup yet:

Our play group just bought several boxes of Black Hand boosters.
Before giving everybody their share, we were wondering how the cards
appear to be spread in boxes. Several copies of the same rare in a box
or mostly different rares? Same question for vampires?

Thank you kindly.

- The Raven - aka Frederic Gingras

I don't know if this is a reliable take, but I bought 26 boosters from
the same box, and it included 3 copies of Sybil's Tongue, 2 copies of
Vendetta and 2 copies of Local 1111. So, 22 different rares out of 26
boosters. Nothing alarming. As I was busy marking my new cards,
another guy wondered of the 3 Talons of the Dead that he already had
when he was opened appr. 20 boosters.

-Antero

Ps. Maybe it is just me, but to my eyes, Midget (at least the right
half of his face) looks like deformed Robin Williams.

Messages.Author: legbiter
Messages.Body:
fred_g...@sympatico.ca (- The Raven -) wrote in message news:<349755de.03111...@posting.google.com>...



i bought three boxes of boosters and one of starters, and i had the
whole set somewhere between the last 5 packs of the first box and the
first 5 of the second. So excellent spread, the R2s really being twice
as common as the R1s. The only oddity is that there are a couple of
library cards that sometimes occupy vampire slots - Recure of the
Homeland is one, maybe Inscription is the other.

Wish I could say the same over this way. I opened two booster boxes
last night. 5, count them 5 Talons of the Dead (3 were from a single
box). 4 Watchtower: Riders. Mind you, I'm only 6 rares short of the
complete set. My only real complaint regarding this is that between
both boxes, I only received two of the !Tremere action card (forget

really, but why would an uncommon appear LESS often than a rare?

I'll chalk it up to a fluke and move on my merry way...otherwise, I
honestly can't complain. The set looks great.
